verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair axis for a game framework and its editor, but the evidence shows no node-based or visual logic system. Phaser Editor's visual tools cover scene composition: drag-and-drop placement, animations, physics bodies and filters. The Game Agent builds gameplay from plain-language prompts, which is AI code generation, not visual scripting, while the core framework is coded in JavaScript/TypeScript and the editor ships a code editor.
